essence: The mantra requires four hundred-thousand-ten-thousand-thousands recitations.
One whose mantra is thus accomplished may perform the applications taught for the ten-syllable mantra.
Performing the applications yields good fortune now and attainment of Hari's abode at death.
The Kṛṣṇa mantra is a three-syllable formula set within the kāma-bīja.
In this mantra, ka is the seed and ī is the power.
